task: Added peaks sidecar source-swap seam: usePeaks accepts an optional suppliedPeaks param, PlayerBar fetches the server-computed sidecar for over-cap clips (design-docs/plans/active/audio_player_completion_004/tasks/008-frontend-peaks-source-swap.md)

frontend/src/app/layout/WaveformTape.tsx.summary: usePeaks(audioUrl, audioEl, suppliedPeaks?) — a non-empty suppliedPeaks short-circuits the fetch+decode effect entirely and is returned directly. WaveformTape threads its existing `peaks` prop into usePeaks so both the canvas and minimap render from a supplied array when present.

frontend/src/app/layout/PlayerBar.tsx.summary: Adds sidecarPeaks state + a fetch effect (fires only when duration > TAPE_DURATION_CAP_SEC), extends tapeAvailable to include the sidecar-present case, passes peaks={sidecarPeaks} into <WaveformTape>.

frontend/src/api/contracts/peaksSidecar..summary: PeaksSidecar type + parsePeaksSidecar(json) -> number[] | null, validating version===1 and [0,1]-range peaks.

frontend/src/api/fetchPeaksSidecar.ts.summary: derivePeaksUrl(audioUrl) -> string | null (chapter-asset shape only) + fetchPeaksSidecar(audioUrl) -> Promise<number[] | null>, calling GET .../assets/peaks.

flow_impact: Long chapters (over TAPE_DURATION_CAP_SEC) can now render the waveform tape fed by the server-computed peaks sidecar (tasks 006/007) instead of requiring a browser AudioContext decode; under-cap clips and any fetch failure keep today's behavior unchanged.
